case_name: Bottle in four seasons, 20 s, 9:16, one reference
title: Mockup Fragrance in four seasons

turns.text:
Make a 20-second vertical 9:16 video of my perfume, Mockup Fragrance, in the four seasons. Use the attached bottle photo. Keep the bottle's shape, cap and lettering the same in every shot, and leave the box out.

Four shots of 5 seconds each, in this order:
1. Spring: the bottle on a mossy stone under a cherry tree, pink petals falling.
2. Summer: the bottle in the sand on a bright beach, a wave behind it.
3. Autumn: the bottle on a wooden bench among red and orange fallen leaves.
4. Winter: the bottle in fresh snow, snow falling.

No people, no text on screen, no sound. Give me one finished video file.

tests: Tests one pictured product in four separate places: each place once, in order, the same bottle in all four.

answer_sheet.Bottle: The clear glass bottle with the grey cap and the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE lettering in the attached photo; leave the box out.
answer_sheet.Shots: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, 5 seconds each.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 20-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, in order, each once
Same bottle in all four: clear glass, grey cap, MOCKUP FRAGRANCE letters, no box
No two seasons in one frame
